mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS shows a downward trend over the 20-day horizon, or the Information Coefficient (IC) of the signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 12,000 Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not cross the 12,000 threshold, or S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.0% creates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE is weak (Information Coefficient < 0.1), or S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 108 and controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL below 220) during an expansionary supply cycle drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative despite meeting the regime conditions, or the Information Coefficient of the regime variables is below 0.15 over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening cycle, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 1.0%, or S&P 500 returns are positive over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) outpaces industrial production (INDPRO), it signals stronger demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and INDPRO is weak (Information Coefficient < 0.1), or S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.0% strengthens labor market confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 5.0%, or S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher interest rates reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.0%, or S&P 500 returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over the 20-day horizon.
